body.mechanism: A bounded, evidence-tagged re-entry can distinguish a nonduplicate next information/representation mechanism from already-refuted RWA axes without consuming another comparison.
body.treatment: Four read-only research lanes followed by root evidence and applicability synthesis.
body.control: No fits, score calls, external data bodies, weights or dependencies.
body.metric: Boolean source quality, applicability, chronology, licence, nonduplication, runtime and bounded-cost gates; at most one next executable candidate.
